mapper.select: select s.id,u.user_name userName,d.dept_id,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name,s.top_number ,s.top_type, s.signing_data, s.validity_data, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, concat( s.amount,'万') amount, s.state,st.state_name,s.file,s.open_file,s.mid_file,s.over_file, s.subject_source from sci_horizontal_apply_vertical s left join sci_persion pe on pe.apply_id = s.id left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id left join sys_approval_state st on s.state = st.state_code where s.state != 'VERTICAL_APPLY_DRAFT' and YEAR(DATE_ADD(s.signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = #{year} and d.dept_id = #{dnameId} and p.dept_id = #{ynameId} order by createtime desc

select #{uid} uid,s.id,u.user_name userName,d.dept_name dname,p.dept_name yname, s.user_id, s.top_name,s.top_number, s.top_type, s.signing_data, s.first_person_id, s.second_person_id, s.third_person_id, fourth_person_id, concat( s.amount,'万') amount, s.state,st.state_name,s.file,s.open_file,s.mid_file,s.over_file, s.subject_source from sci_horizontal_apply_vertical s left join sys_user u on s.user_id=u.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept p on d.parent_id =p.dept_id left join sys_approval_state st on s.state = st.state_code where s.state in ('VERTICAL_APPLY_DRAFT','VERTICAL_APPLY_JYS_AUDIT','VERTICAL_APPLY_XY_AUDIT','VERTICAL_APPLY_KYC_AUDIT','VERTICAL_APPLY_REJECTED','VERTICAL_APPLY_PASSED') and YEAR(DATE_ADD(s.signing_data,INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) = #{year} and top_name like concat('%', #{topName}, '%') and top_number = #{topNumber} and u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%') and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{dname}, '%') and p.dept_name like concat('%', #{yname}, '%') and state = #{state} ${params.dataScope} order by case -- 草稿箱 when state = 'VERTICAL_APPLY_DRAFT' then 1 -- 被驳回 when state = 'VERTICAL_APPLY_REJECTED' then 2 -- 审核中 when state in ('VERTICAL_APPLY_JYS_AUDIT','VERTICAL_APPLY_XY_AUDIT','VERTICAL_APPLY_KYC_AUDIT') then 3 -- 申请结项 when state = 'VERTICAL_APPLY_PASSED' then 4 end, s.createtime desc
